Name: Default Domain Policy
Settings: Password and account lockout policy only: min length 14; complexity on; history 24; max age 0 (never); lockout 10 attempts / 15 min

Name: Default Domain Controllers Policy
Settings: Left at defaults (user rights for DCs)

Name: C-DomainControllers-Audit
Settings: Advanced audit policy (logon; account management; DS changes; Kerberos); Security log 1 GB

Name: C-AllComputers-SecurityBaseline
Settings: LLMNR off; NTLMv2 only; SMB signing required; Defender Firewall on for all profiles; 10 min inactivity lock; logon banner

Name: C-Workstations-LAPS
Settings: Windows LAPS to AD; 16 chars; 30 days; encrypted; decryptable by GG_IT_WorkstationAdmins; reset after use

Name: C-Servers-LAPS
Settings: Windows LAPS to AD; 20 chars; 30 days; encrypted; decryptable by Domain Admins only

Name: C-Workstations-LocalAdmins
Settings: GPP Local Users and Groups: Administrators = built-in Administrator (LAPS) + GG_IT_WorkstationAdmins; all other members removed

Name: C-Servers-LocalAdmins
Settings: GPP Local Users and Groups: Administrators = built-in Administrator (LAPS) + Domain Admins + GG_IT_ServerAdmins

Name: C-Workstations-UserRights
Settings: Deny log on locally / through RDP / as batch / as service: Domain Admins; Enterprise Admins; Schema Admins

Name: C-Workstations-BitLocker
Settings: XTS-AES 256 for OS drive; recovery password required and backed up to AD DS before encryption starts

Name: U-AllUsers-DriveMappings
Settings: GPP drive maps with item-level targeting: S: Company; T: own department; M: Managers; P: Payroll-Inputs; I: IT

Name: U-AllUsers-Baseline
Settings: Password-protected screen saver after 10 min; AutoRun off for all drives

Name: U-FinanceHR-RemovableStorage
Settings: Deny write access to removable disks (USB sticks) - Authenticated Users keep Read so the computer can read the GPO (MS16-072)

Name: C-Workstations-OneDrive
Settings: OneDrive: silent sign-in with the Windows account; Known Folder Move (Desktop/Documents/Pictures) silently with notification; block opt-out; Files On-Demand

Name: U-AllUsers-Printers
Settings: GPP shared printers from the TC-FS01 print server: TC-PRN01 for GG_All_Staff (default); TC-PRN02 for GG_Finance_Users only
